title: Help! About the A Touch of Opulence Tileset DLC for MV

posts.author: newgenin
posts.body:
Hello guys, i'm learning how to make games with RPG maker MV.
Everything is going great and i decided to buy the dlc A Touch of Opulence Tileset because i feel it fits the vibe my game project is aiming for.
however when using tilesets from this dlc, i am really confused because i don't understand how the borders and walls work, so when i put them on the map, everything seems to be broken.
So can you guys help me understand more about how to build a room with this tileset?
Thank you very much and sorry for my english is not really good
Here are some pictures of this tilesets. As you can see, the borders are not connected and different from the default MV tilesets, and the part that i assume is the floor mat also has white space in the corner...

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
How has the tileset been set up in your database?
At a glance it looks like the autotiles have been put in the wrong section, but I'm not familiar with the tileset so I don't know.
